EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Whenever we have an event,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I feel
like the whole town becomes united
with a sense of harmony!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}I mark all the dates on my calendar
so I don't ever miss anything!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Let me see{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh, man,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} there aren't
any events anytime soon. Bummer!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}How will we be harmonious?!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Siempre que se celebra algún
acontecimiento en el pueblo,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
¡reina la paz y la armonía!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Por eso apunto las fechas de todos
los acontecimientos importantes en
mi agenda.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Déjame ver{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Jo,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} vaya mala pata!
No hay nada interesante a la vista.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dès qu'un événement se prépare,
on peut sentir une atmosphère
d'excitation dans toute la ville !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Je note toutes les dates
importantes sur mon calendrier
pour ne rien manquer !
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Voyons{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh flûte,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} rien n'est prévu
prochainement !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Trop nul !

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ogni volta che c'è un evento,
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}è come se la città e i suoi abitanti
diventassero un tutt'uno!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Io mi segno tutte le date
sul calendario, così non me ne
perdo nemmeno uno!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Vediamo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh sorbole,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} non ci sono
eventi nei prossimi giorni...

grenzenlose Harmonie in {{TAG:0005:0005:}}

meinem Kalender an, damit ich

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Mal sehen...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}In nächster Zeit steht
leider kein Feiertag an.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Schade!

ne olacak şimdi?!

Veranstaltungen ausdenken!

thon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ou s'asseoir sur un banc et
